Fit score methodology (0–100) — renovation & operating costs are estimates
  • Cost 39: all-in price (incl. buying fees) + estimated renovation midpoint + 10 years of estimated operating costs. ≤ €420k = full, ≥ €700k = 0.
  • Commute 21: public transport to the 8th district 13 (≤ 55 min full, ≥ 110 min 0) · car to the 21st district 8 (≤ 20 min full, ≥ 55 min 0).
  • Move-in readiness 14 (from finish status, condition notes, description keywords and the renovation estimate): ready / new / renovated / schlüsselfertig / Erstbezug 14 · minor updates (paint, kitchen/bath) ~10.5 · partial renovation ~6.3 · belagsfertig 7 · renovation needed ~2.8 · full gut (Kernsanierung/Generalsanierung needed, Abriss, Rohbau, Bastlerhit, “stark/komplett sanierungsbedürftig”) 0 and −8 penalty. A Generalsanierung already carried out counts as renovated.
  • Space 15: living area 7 (90→150 m²) · estimated garden 8 (plot minus ~60% of living area; 100→600 m²; unknown = 1).
  • Cellar/storage 4 (cellar 4, other storage 2, unknown 0) · 5th room 4 · Sauna 3.
  • Penalties: fewer than 4 rooms −25 · rooms unknown −8 · not a family-home type −15 · full gut −8.
  • Renovation rules of thumb (Austria 2026, € per m² living, estimates, not quotes): turnkey €0–10k · belagsfertig €250–450 · Rohbau €1,100–1,700 · renovation needed €500–1,000 (heavy/pre-1960/HWB F–G €700–1,400) · finish unknown by year built/HWB: ≥2010 or A–B €0–15k, 1990–2009 or C €80–250, 1970–89 or D–E €250–600, older or F–G €450–900, nothing known €150–500 · oil heating +€15–25k.
  • Operating costs (estimate): Betriebskosten from the listing, else €150/month assumed; heating = HWB × m² × €0.12/kWh (heat pump €0.07).
  • Highly recommended: ≥ 4 rooms, family home, not a full gut, total-cost midpoint ≤ ~€510k, public transport ≤ 80 min or car ≤ 40 min, score ≥ 50; best 8 at most (cap relaxes if fewer than 3 qualify). Rescored on every watch run against the current market. Worth a look: score ≥ 55.

Offline-capable when opened as file:// (data embedded). Leaflet + Chart.js from jsDelivr CDN; OSM map tiles need network. Research-only · no agent contact · lat/lon = town centroids · generated 2026-09-20 · fees update 2026-09-24 · BK update 2026-09-24 · commute update 2026-09-24.
All-in Nebenkosten (buyer-side, on asking price): Grunderwerbsteuer 3.5% + Grundbucheintragung 1.1% + Notar/Anwalt Vertragserrichtung ~1.5% (estimate) = 6.1% statutory; plus Maklerprovision 3.0%+20% USt = 3.6% only when Seller=Makler (buyer pays). Privat / provisionsfrei / unknown → Makler 0. €/m² = asking ÷ living m². Hover All-in € or Seller for per-row evidence.
BK €/Mo = monatliche Betriebskosten from the listing (willhaben MONTHCOSTS_GROSS / portal labels). Null/"—" when not stated — prefer unknown over guessing. Tooltip shows source note (inkl./exkl. Heizung when known).
Heating = the system the listing names (gas, air-source heat pump, geothermal, oil, pellets, wood, district heating, electric, or a combination). Hover the cell for the German phrase. Unknown means no fuel was named. Solar and an open fireplace stay in that note unless they are the only system.
Drive min = OSRM free-flow/off-peak-ish car minutes to the 21st district (not rush-hour peak). PT min = public transport minutes, VAO/AnachB HAFAS best weekday ~10:00 door-to-door to the 8th district.

Monthly cost = annuity payment on (all-in price + renovation midpoint − own funds) + estimated running costs (Betriebskosten + heating). KIM-V check (Austrian mortgage rules; banks still apply these thresholds): loan ≤ 90% of price incl. fees, payment ≤ 40% of net income, term ≤ 35 years. Estimate only — not financial advice. Defaults: 20% own funds, 3.5% fixed, 30 years.
